description: Market Profile value-area migration across sessions: is value migrating up, down, or overlapping (directional conviction vs balance)? Use for "is value moving higher day over day?". Returns: state, direction, migration_pct, key_levels (current vs. prior session VAH/VAL/VPOC), tails (session-high/low rejection tails and single prints), scenario_framing, invalidation level. Candles come from the venue when candles[] is omitted (past sessions are cached, so repeats are fast); supplying candles[] makes the run network-free and reproducible. session_date must be a completed UTC session, before today; a session with no candles returns an error. Edge cases: instrument non-empty and venue binance or bybit; session_date is a completed UTC session before today; timeframe 1m, 5m, 15m or 30m (default 15m); value_area_rule 0.5 to 0.9 (default 0.70); supplied candles must each have high at or above low, open and close, low at or below them, and volume 0 or more; a session with no candles is an error. lookback_sessions a whole number 1 to 5 (default 1). Not covered: order flow beyond the candles given, other venues, and any statement about what price will do; the output describes the session and is not a signal.

candles.description: Optional OHLCV for the session; omit to fetch from venue (reproducible + 0 COGS when supplied)

prev_candles.description: Optional OHLCV for the previous session

session_date.description: Session date YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); must be before today (a completed session)

venue.description: Exchange to fetch candles from when candles[] not supplied

name: workflow.run_value_migration
title: Market Profile: Value Migration
